name: Soyuz T-6
about: Soyuz T-6 (1982-063A), a crewed vehicle (7K-ST), launched 1982 Jun 24. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1982 Jun 26), held fixed
docked to S13138; GCAT's later phases (auxiliary catalogues) are not read yet
